title: no user name, host name, peer address, tailnet name or credential pattern in any script
titleZh: 任何脚本里都没有用户名/主机名/对端 IP/tailnet 名/凭据样式
why: MEASURED lesson from the skill: scripts/verify.ps1 carried a real peer address inside its comment-based help, which is the code face, not the doc face. A clone that ships one real address is a clone that cannot be published safely. The script surface therefore gets no allowlist at all in this scan.
inject: the plugin's own *.ps1 / *.psm1 / *.js / *.mjs files, scanned with the six patterns from defensive-spec section 2.1
expectSummary: 0 hits (no allowlist for the script surface)
